hypothesis: Keep the calibrated three-axis symmetric magnetic residual, full innovation covariance and cross-covariance gains, but project only its attitude gain onto current world vertical. This isolates tilt correction from the earlier scalar heading-only ablation, which also suppressed velocity and accelerometer-bias gains. Existing arbitrary-gain Joseph covariance is retained.
scope: Known-seed development ablation, generated-C substitution equivalent to passing to_DCM(predicted.quaternionWorldBody)[3,:] as attitudeGainAxis with headingOnly=false in the vector magnetic correction. Not a full EqF, theoretical dominance proof, Modelica export, or production change.
decision: Retain all GPS, denied and transition outcomes for all four variants. Reject general replacement for substantial position/velocity/attitude regressions.
